value.account:
WHAT I CHANGED
- State: RunState.result_persistence_profile (omitted from to_dict when None, validated at construction/from_dict/StateManager.initialize, load failure never rewrites the file). StateManager gained begin_eligible_pure_visit / reuse_interrupted_eligible_pure_visit / settle_eligible_pure_success / settle_eligible_pure_failure (one state_transaction each); call-frame managers got the same four via the scoped aggregate-root mutation. Leaf mutations live in pure_result_replay.py so both managers share them.
- Selection: orchestrator run and resume --force-restart pass the profile to initialize; a fresh non-iterative child frame (existing_frame is None, step_name_override is None) selects it from the callee bundle's frontend_kind. _CallFrameStateManager now takes result_persistence_profile and rejects a malformed existing frame ('existing call-frame state') before mkdir; load_existing_call_frame_read_only returns a deep-copied RunState. force-restart no longer rewrites the source run's observability (it only goes to the new root).
- New modules (orchestrator/workflow): pure_result_replay (public facade: shell, classify_pure_replay_progress, leaf mutations, lazy PureReplayRuntime), pure_result_replay_index (derive_pure_result_replay_index, typed addresses, SCC-based multiple-visit detection, _propagate_pure_ineligibility), pure_binding_documents (ref-leaf walk + typed literal check incl. inactive union members), pure_result_replay_errors, pure_result_replay_runtime (PureReplayRuntime: witnesses, process-local cache with revalidation on every hit, overlay, leaf audit, boundary seeds, persisted-surface audit with profile_conflict surfaces), pure_replay_executor (PureReplayCoordinator composed into WorkflowExecutor).
- Executor: pre-prologue surface+progress audit (conflicts raise PureResultReplayIndexError, other failures become error.type pure_result_replay_unavailable); restart boundary is now determined once in execute() and threaded into ResumePlanner.determine_default_resume_decision(restart_node_id=...); replay runs after that, before the default-resume decision and before any effect; eligible nodes begin their visit via the manager instead of increment+start_step, skip result bundles (execute_pure_projection(persist_bundle=False)), and settle through OutcomeRecorder(eligible_pure_settlement=witness) which keeps the full result in memory and passes the exact shell to the summary emitter. Provider observation manager is now created at execute() start and closed once.
- Checkpoints: eligible pure points emit no record, their restore bindings are omitted, select_restore_candidate and _nearest_prior_effect_boundary filter them before nearest selection, and determine_runtime_default_resume_decision admits the single VALIDATED_FRAME_ENTRY_REPLAY zero-record case (else FAIL_CLOSED with prior_boundary_not_restorable).
- specs/state.md documents the contract; docs/plans/2026-10-19-... records approach/alternatives; tests/test_derived_pure_replay_profile.py (85 behavioural tests); tests/test_provider_observation_workflow.py updated for the lazy manager.

VERIFICATION
- New tests pass; full suite (xdist) shows only failures that also fail on an untouched git-archive copy of HEAD (socket/network/tmux/nanobragg/golden-hash/missing-evidence tests) plus one load-flaky test that passes alone. Real CLI smoke: orchestrator run selects the profile, resume --force-restart selects it and leaves the source state.json byte-identical. Interrupt/resume matrices on two scratch .orc programs (commands + pure + call frames) and lexical_checkpoint_effect_policies/restore_regions fixtures reproduce outputs without repeating committed effects.

DECISIONS AND DISCARDED ALTERNATIVES
- Eligibility also excludes pure nodes with publishes/consumes and nodes without a top-level execution index (not in spec): skipping lineage for them would silently break consumers. All 42 pure nodes in repo fixtures have none.
- Replay is seeded from the remaining program's references (scan of IR config strings: presentation key, node id, step id, 'steps.<key>') plus workflow outputs, not 'replay everything completed', so unused values cannot fail a resume. A string scan is coarse; it can over-include but not under-include typed predicate addresses.
- Skips/guard failures of eligible nodes happen before the old visit increment, so _persist_step_result begins the visit on demand; otherwise skipped rows would be 'row without visit' and classify as invalid.
- Default-resume decision classifies progress on a durable_view of the state because the executor overlays replayed values into the in-memory state before the decision.
- Kept executor._determine_resume_default_resume_decision(state) one-argument (existing tests monkeypatch it) and pass the boundary via an attribute.
- Discarded: git stash for baseline comparison (killed run left changes stashed; restored immediately), a baseline via git worktree (forbidden by AGENTS.md; used a throwaway git-archive copy instead and deleted it).

NOT COVERED / RISKS
- The spec leaves several shapes open; I guessed: evaluate_node(node, overlay) (single-arg callables tolerated), resolve_bundle_path receives a str subclass of the node id that also exposes node attributes and may return a workspace-relative path, load_existing_call_frame_read_only returns a RunState, PureBinding.address is my PureStateAddress(kind, name, member), PureReplayRuntime.index.scope_kind is always 'root' (also for child scope paths).
- No dedicated tests for iteration-owned frames, non-Workflow-Lisp callees, fresh retry after failed predecessor (existing subworkflow tests still pass), or the checkpoint_record/restore_payload conflict surfaces; no CLI-level test for resume of an unsupported profile. A resumed child frame whose callee has no checkpoint points still hits the pre-existing lexical_default_resume_schema_invalid path.
- Dashboards/readers of state.json that expect steps.<pure>.artifacts see shells; the CLI resume path still marks the run failed after an uncaught profile_conflict exception. pure_result_replay_runtime.py is ~505 lines (slightly over the 500-line guideline). Nothing was committed.
